scenarios.criterion: The view MUST draw every expedition GET /api/expeditions returns for the current adventurer as a geodesic polyline, both ends within 1 km of its stored ends, tagged with saturdayMetadata { id, name, kind: 'expedition' }.
scenarios.name: Signed-out adventurer sees only the shop's seeded expeditions drawn on the globe
given: The reagent map view has loaded
when: The globe finishes loading expeditions from GET /api/expeditions
then: Exactly three expeditions are drawn: 'Spring to Crag', 'Glade to Caves', and 'Cairn to Shoals'
Each drawn expedition is a geodesic line with both ends within 1 km of its stored reagent site coordinates
Each drawn expedition carries saturdayMetadata with id, name, and kind: 'expedition'

scenarios.criterion: The view MUST draw every expedition GET /api/expeditions returns for the current adventurer as a geodesic polyline, both ends within 1 km of its stored ends, tagged with saturdayMetadata { id, name, kind: 'expedition' }.
scenarios.name: Signed-in adventurer sees the seeded expeditions plus their own, never another adventurer's
given: The reagent map view has loaded
when: The globe finishes loading expeditions from GET /api/expeditions
then: The three seeded expeditions ('Spring to Crag', 'Glade to Caves', 'Cairn to Shoals') are drawn
'Moonwell Spring to Frostcap Hollow' is also drawn
'Ember Crag to Saltmarsh Cairn' is not drawn

scenarios.criterion: Choosing a site from the list MUST fly the camera so that site lands on screen on the near side of the globe, including a site that starts on the far side.
scenarios.name: Choosing a far-side site from the list flies the camera so it lands on screen on the near side
given: Tidewrack Shoals is on the far side of the globe and not on screen
when: The adventurer chooses Tidewrack Shoals from the site list
then: The camera flies so Tidewrack Shoals lands on screen on the near side of the globe

scenarios.criterion: The @visual globe baseline MUST change only because the newly drawn expeditions now appear in it. Regenerate it in both runner images, view each changed PNG, and record what changed and why. No other baseline changes, and no tolerance is raised.
scenarios.name: Drawing expeditions on the globe changes only the globe baseline image
given: The expeditions are now drawn on the globe by this change
when: The visual baseline suite is regenerated with --update-baselines in both runner images
then: Only globe-default-view.png differs from its prior baseline, in each image
reagent-map-header.png, reagent-site-list.png, and reagent-map-error.png remain byte-identical to their prior baselines
No existing visual-diff tolerance is raised to make a difference pass
